searchText: So i was looking through the test vectors here and one of the new test cases uses a https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/ethereum/eth2.0-spec-tests/v1.0-rc-0/tests/general/phase0/bls/fast_aggregate_verify/small/fast_aggregate_verify_infinity_pubkey/data.yaml `messages` field, when every other test case uses a `message` field. This has already been raised and fixed here: https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/pull/2099 But the generated test cases haven't been updated, I can work around it for now, but would be easier to have them fixed soon too. I have a few more test vectors under review. I can cut an rc-1 with fixed vectors by tomorrow perfect, that sounds great 👍 are spec tests compliant with BLSv4? I tried to update blst to blsv4 and spec tests failing. Not sure if the issue is in blst or spec tests. Did you use v1.0.0-rc.0 spec tests? (See: https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/pull/7469/files#diff-5493ff8e9397811510e780de47c57abb70137f1afe85d1519130dc3679d60ce5R222) I don't see it's updated in this PR (https://github.com/prysmaticlabs/prysm/pull/7644) <@399309815517544451> there are some changes we need to do
